title: Bulk change
pickBlueprint: Pick a blueprint above to change its entities in bulk.
empty: Nothing to show — no entities of this blueprint match.
selectGroupAria_one: Select {{count}} entity in the branch of {{name}}
selectGroupAria_other: Select all {{count}} entities in the branch of {{name}}
overCap: Select at most {{max}} entities per bulk change.
valueRequired: Enter a value to set. To remove the value, use Clear.

summary.check: Will be updated: {{updated}}, unchanged: {{unchanged}}, cannot be changed: {{failed}}.

modal.title: Bulk change
modal.intro_one: Change one field of {{count}} selected {{blueprint}} entity.
modal.intro_other: Change one field of {{count}} selected {{blueprint}} entities.

operationHint.SET: Replaces the current value on every selected entity.
operationHint.CLEAR: Removes the value from every selected entity.
operationHint.ADD: Adds the items below to the current list; items already there are kept once.
operationHint.REMOVE: Removes the items below from the current list; a list left empty loses the field.

preview.intro: Preview of “{{operation}}” on “{{field}}” — nothing is stored until you apply it.

result.failedHint: Entities that were not changed stay selected, so you can fix them and try again.

error.invalid: The server refused this change. Check the field and value, or select fewer entities, and try again.
error.busy: The server is busy reading other data. Try again in a moment.
error.applyUnknown: The result is unknown: the request failed or timed out, so some entities may already have been changed. Go back and preview again before trying anything else.
